content.text: Turns out this is a fairly large undertaking. I will plan to split it up into smaller bite-sized pieces. See, for instance fcrepo-1848 as a start. I suspect this will make review easier, too.
This is more of an umbrella issue, but once this PR is merged, it will be complete:
The fedora kernel should not depend on JCR interfaces. This ticket will track the removal of all things jcr from the fcrepo-kernel-api module.
